added.title: 812301 Software Engineer $280,000.00
added.description:
Labor Category: Software Engineer

Position Title: Software Engineer

Position Level: Level 2 – Expert

Salary: Up to $280,000.00 per year

Core Hours: 9am to 4pm

Location: Herndon VA

Description

Position Requires a Top Secret (TS/SCI) Clearance with a Polygraph.

We are looking for a driven software developer in Herndon, VA to join an elite team of Software Developers, Data Engineers, and System Engineers who are developing and deploying unprecedented capabilities for the Intelligence Community. (Potential for Remote work up to 2 days a week after 6 months)

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

Front-end development of applications with expertise in UI/UX, creating intuitive user interface designs

Understand requirements to design and develop software components

Prepare design mockups for new software features to get customer buy-in to proceed with development

Work with team members to understand the current product features

Perform unit testing and work with independent testers when preparing to deploy new features/functionality

Participate in the project’s agile process

Effectively communicate among developers, as well as with end-users on a limited basis

Possess excellent problem-solving skills, and be detail-oriented and performance-driven

Commitment to continuous process improvement

Details

Labor Category: Software Engineer

Position Title: Software Engineer

Position Level: Level 2 – Expert

Salary: Up to $280,000.00 per year

Core Hours: 9am to 4pm

Location: Herndon VA

Mandatory Requirements

Developmental (0-2 years’ experience)
Full Performance (3-5 years’ experience)
Senior (6-10 years’ experience)
Expert (11-15 years’ experience)
SME (16+ years’ experience)

11+ years of relevant development experience

Experience developing in Python

Experience using Vue.js, HTML, CSS

Working in Linux and Windows environments

Results-driven with good critical thinking and problem-solving skills

Ability to provide leadership in a team setting and mentor other developers on an as-needed basis

Optional Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field

Experience with Node.js

Experience with Agile development

Familiar with ADA guidelines for software accessibility

GitLab/GitHub

B4CORP Company Information

B4Corp is a small defense contracting company that focuses on providing an optimum environment for mission-focused, highly skilled consultants to support the United States of America’s intelligence community and other defense organizations. B4Corp provides a low overhead, highly efficient, high salary environment that allows employees to excel at meeting the client’s needs. B4Corp is looking for information technology professionals that have a high sense of personal responsibility, self-motivation, and mission drive.

B4Corp’s dedication and care for its employees is reflected in our outstanding compensation and benefits package. B4Corp’s benefits reflect the company’s policy of putting the employees first. B4Corp’s maximum flexibility comp / makeup time policy, along with the company’s cafeteria-style benefit plan that allows employees to maximize their Benefit Dollars, reflects B4Corp’s commitment to its employees.

Compensation

Outstanding Salaries

Retirement

Full Vanguard 401k Plan – Featuring a full scope of investment options – 100% employer matched contribution up to 6% of employee’s salary – Ability to max out 401k savings $57k ($63.5k if over 50)
Employees receive B4Corp phantom stock each year (2-year vesting period)

Insurance

Medical – United Health Care (UHC) (multiple plan options)
Dental – United Concordia (UC) Flex Plan
Vision – Vision Service Plan Insurance Co (VSP) Signature Plans
Mutual of Omaha short-term disability (60% of salary up to $2,000.00/week)
Mutual of Omaha long-term disability (60% of salary up to $10,000.00/month)
Mutual of Omaha life insurance ($200,000.00)

Employee Referral Bonus

Refer a friend or a coworker and receive $3,000 per year for every year the person works for B4CORP

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Seven weeks of leave per year (including ten federal holidays)
Flexible work schedule with comp time (with customer approval)

Internal Tracking -MS-HLV-7

added.title: 812302 Software Engineer $265,000.00
added.description:
Labor Category: Software Engineer

Position Title: Software Developer

Position Level: Level 2 – Expert

Salary: Up to $265,000.00 per year

Core Hours: 9am to 4pm

Location: Herndon VA

Description

Position Requires a Top Secret (TS/SCI) Clearance with a Polygraph.

We’re seeking a Software Developer/Systems Engineer to build and maintain enterprise data feeds that power our network and security intelligence platforms. You’ll integrate data from multiple vendor APIs, create robust ETL pipelines, and leverage AI to handle complex data extraction and normalization challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Design and maintain enterprise data feeds from 10+network and security vendor APIs;
Build intelligent parsers that handle diverse data formats;
Orchestrate automated pipelines for regular data download, transformation and loading;
Ensure reliability and performance through monitoring, error handling, and optimization;
Adapt to change by quickly resolving API updates, data format changes, and vendor issues;
Integrate AI capabilities for data extraction, classification, anomaly detection, and auto-healing.
Perform technical evaluations of new tools for potential use and positive impact on project processes
